     *     https}.

methods.name: public Builder header(String name, String value)
methods.comment:
* Sets the header named {@code name} to {@code value}. If this request
     * already has any headers with that name, they are all replaced.

methods.name: public Builder addHeader(String name, String value)
methods.comment:
* Adds a header with {@code name} and {@code value}. Prefer this method for * multiply-valued headers like "Cookie". * *

Note that for some headers including {@code Content-Length} and {@code Content-Encoding}, * OkHttp may replace {@code value} with a header derived from the request body.

methods.name: public Builder headers(Headers headers)
methods.comment: Removes all headers on this builder and adds {@code headers}.

methods.name: public Builder cacheControl(CacheControl cacheControl)
methods.comment:
* Sets this request's {@code Cache-Control} header, replacing any cache
     * control headers already present. If {@code cacheControl} doesn't define
     * any directives, this clears this request's cache-control headers.
